summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily open-market share repurchases from May 11-15, 2026, totaling 1,671,851 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices of 1,855.48 to 1,882.24 GBp. The purchases were executed by Citigroup Global Markets Limited under a non-discretionary agreement dated May 8, 2026, with shares held as treasury. The treasury now holds 263,050,137 shares (6.49% of voting rights). This is an open-market buyback program, not a tender offer. No premium or fixed price is specified, as purchases are made at prevailing market prices. The program reduces share count and can enhance EPS. Watch for continuation or completion updates as the program progresses.
